name: liquidity_provision_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional VWAP algorithms account for ~20-30% of daily buy-side volume and operate with a natural mean-reverting footprint: when NIFTY briefly dips below the tight VWAP lower band (0.5 σ computed over the recent 5 minutes), VWAP algos accelerate order submission because they're getting fills at prices significantly better than their benchmark — this burst of demand drives price back toward VWAP within 15-90 seconds. The reverse applies at the upper band, where VWAP sell-side algorithms unload at favourable prices, creating a ceiling. This effect is strongest when volume participation is normal (confirming active VWAP algo presence) and VIX < 18 (in high-VIX regimes, trend/panic flow overwhelms VWAP benchmark logic).
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY deviates beyond 0.5-sigma VWAP band in normal volume regime triggering VWAP algo re-entry reversion
